in_sanskrit.name: Pachu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Little Goddess
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Pachu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Pachu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Pacha' meaning 'five'. This name is believed to be a diminutive form of the name 'Panchami' which is the name of the fifth Goddess Durga. The name Pachu is thus a symbol of the divine feminine and is believed to bring blessings of prosperity and good fortune.
